actions.reason: C0001 has coherent RNA (E2F/MYC/G2M proliferative program) and CNV (PTEN/chr10q loss, chr12 gain) identity evidence; the CT scanner-model association does not plausibly explain the RNA/CNV-defined signal, and cross-modal membership is non-degenerate with positive boundaries. Structure is weak but not incompatible, so the candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0002 shows convergent PBRM1-mutant, BAP1-wildtype identity evidence across WXS, CNV, and RNA, with no set-specific technical confounder and positive cross-modal boundaries. Structural support is modest but not incompatible, so the candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0003 has strong BAP1-mutation enrichment with PBRM1 depletion and coordinated angiogenesis-low RNA downregulation; the tissue-source-site association does not plausibly explain the WXS/RNA-defined signal, and resampling stability is the highest among sets. Structure is weak but not incompatible, so the candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0004 has no significant biological signal in any modality after correction, and its cross-modal structure is dominated by a single WXS modality with zero all-estimable-positive membership support. The weak VHL-high/PBRM1-low trend does not constitute a defensible discovery-stage candidate, and no structural revision resolves this.

C0005's only significant biological signal is VHL/PBRM1 wildtype status by WXS, with no significant RNA or CNV support and cross-modal structure dominated by a single modality (median membership support 1). This single-modality signal is insufficient to define a defensible multimodal discovery-stage candidate, and no structural revision resolves this.
